Indications of NaHCO3:metabolic acidosis in cardiac arrest, Tricyclic antidepressants, aspirin and phenobarbitone overdoses, Hyperkalemia, Crush injuries, C\/I \u0026nbsp;in certain conditions because of adverse reactions like Hypernatremia, metabolic alkalosis, cellulitis, seizures, tetany, sodium retention, peripheral edema. \u0026nbsp;
